title: Team Lead – Control System Engineering
description:
**Lead the engineering team behind PLC, SCADA and OT Cybersecurity projects for Oil & Gas clients.**

Consyst is hiring a Team Lead – Control System Engineering to own the quality of every engineering package we deliver, from design through FAT, SAT and commissioning, while growing a team of control-system engineers.

📍 Kochi (Kerala) or Nagpur | On-site | Full-time

🧭 6+ years in industrial control and automation design, including 2+ years leading engineers

**What you'll do**

* Lead, plan and allocate work across the engineering team so projects are delivered on time with balanced workloads.
* Prepare and review all deliverables before client submission: GA, wiring and loop drawings, I/O lists, system architecture, network drawings, control philosophy, FDS, logic diagrams, cable schedules and FAT/SAT procedures.
* Review and validate PLC/RTU logic and SCADA screens against the FDS.
* Set and enforce drawing standards, design templates and best practices (IEC/NFPA and client specifications).
* Review client specifications, P&IDs and tender documents; lead technical clarification meetings and issue TQs.
* Provide engineering input on SIS requirements, SIL allocation and BPCS/SIS interfaces (IEC 61511), and ensure ATEX/IECEx compliance in equipment selection, panel design and field wiring.
* Manage scope, deliverable registers and schedules across multiple concurrent projects; support pre-bid scope definition and manhour estimation.
* Review vendor submittals, BoMs and datasheets; coordinate handover to Site Services and act as the senior escalation point during FAT, SAT and commissioning.
* Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, run performance reviews and recommend training or recruitment.

**What you bring**

* BE/BTech in Electrical & Electronics, Electronics & Instrumentation, Electronics & Communication or a related field.
* 6+ years in industrial control and automation system design, with 2+ years in a lead role.
* Full engineering packages for PLC, RTU, SCADA and HMI projects in Oil & Gas or allied process industries.
* EPLAN Electric P8 or AutoCAD Electrical.
* Rockwell (Studio 5000, ControlLogix, FactoryTalk), Siemens (TIA Portal, WinCC) or Schneider Electric platforms.
* Protocols: Modbus RTU/TCP, Profibus/Profinet, DNP3, IEC 61850, IEC 104, MQTT; networks: Ethernet, fibre optic, RS232, RS485.
* Working knowledge of functional safety (IEC 61511/SIL) and hazardous area classification (ATEX/IECEx).
* A strong review and QA mindset, people management skills and clear client-facing communication.

**Good to have**

* OT cybersecurity (IEC 62443) project experience.
* Substation automation (IEC 61850) exposure.

**Why Consyst**

* A clear path to senior leadership, with structured development programs and cross-domain exposure.
* Lead PLC, SCADA and OT Cybersecurity projects for leading Oil & Gas clients.
* A collaborative team where your technical decisions shape project success and company growth.

**How to apply**

Apply here on LinkedIn and answer the short screening questions. Know someone who fits? Tag them or share this post.

Learn more about Consyst: https://consyst.biz/careers/

title: Mechanical Engineering Intern
description:
Mechanical Engineer – Motor Accident Inspection & Forensic Investigation

**Company Name:**
Code F Solutions Private Limited

**Department:**
Motor Investigation & Forensic Services

**Job Location:**
Nagpur, Maharashtra

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

1. About Code F Solutions

Code F Solutions Private Limited is a forensic and investigation services company providing specialized solutions in forensic science, cyber forensics, motor accident investigation, and technical investigation services.

We are looking for a technically skilled and detail-oriented Mechanical Engineer to join our team and contribute to motor accident inspections, vehicle damage analysis, and forensic investigation assignments.

2. Job Responsibilities

* Conduct physical inspections of vehicles involved in road accidents.
* Examine vehicle damage, impact points, and mechanical components.
* Analyze accident-related evidence and identify possible causes of vehicle damage.
* Inspect damaged vehicles and document relevant technical observations.
* Prepare detailed inspection reports supported by photographs and technical findings.
* Conduct site visits and vehicle inspections at workshops, garages, accident locations, and other assigned locations.
* Assist in accident reconstruction and forensic investigation activities.
* Coordinate with the internal investigation team, field officers, and other stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate records, photographs, and case documentation.
* Complete assigned investigations and submit reports within the prescribed timelines.
* Travel as required for field inspections and investigation assignments.

3. Educational Qualifications

* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering.
* Freshers and experienced candidates may apply.
* Knowledge of automobile engineering, vehicle systems, and mechanical components will be an advantage.

4. Required Skills

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Knowledge of automobile mechanics and vehicle damage assessment.
* Good observation and technical documentation skills.
* Ability to prepare clear and structured technical reports.
* Proficiency in MS Office and basic computer applications.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Willingness to travel for field inspections.
* Attention to detail, professional integrity, and a responsible approach to investigations.

5. Preferred Experience

* Experience in automobile workshops, vehicle inspection, motor insurance, accident investigation, or automobile damage assessment will be preferred.
* Freshers with strong technical knowledge and a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.

6. What We Offer

* Practical exposure to motor accident investigation and forensic services.
* Opportunities to work on real-world vehicle inspection cases.
* Professional learning and skill development.
* An opportunity to build a career at the intersection of mechanical engineering, insurance investigation, and forensic analysis.

7. How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated resume at:

**Email:**
hr@codefsolutions.com

**Website:**
www.codefsolutions.com

**Company:**
Code F Solutions Private Limited

**Subject Line:**
Application for Mechanical Engineer – Motor Accident Inspection

*Join Code F Solutions and apply your engineering expertise to technical investigation and forensic analysis.*
